about: ThermoPro TP17 cooling from 156 to 90 F after a kettle test, filmed on an iPhone in daylight (Nov 17). A reddish reflection sits still on the upper right segment of the hundreds digit for the whole clip, and a grey reflection dims the upper half of all digits. The reading goes from three digits to two at 24.4 s (102 -> 99). Frames are every 2nd frame of a 30 fps 960x540 video, cropped to 400x200 at (340,230).
digitBoxNote: A tight box around the two right-hand digits, in pixels of these frames: what a user would draw at room temperature. The hundreds digit (a narrow 1 here) sits at x 132..148; a full hundreds digit would start near x 87. The SET TEMP degree sign and F are at x 10..37.
changesNote: t is the 30 fps frame number / 30. The display redraws every 15 frames (0.5 s), phase 13. Values read by eye from one frame per redraw; change frames from frame differencing. From 0.07 s before a change to 0.2 s after it either the old or the new value is correct.
